```yaml
name: Labeler

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Step input validation
        id: validate-step-input
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ github.event.issue.labels }}" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Step input validation failed:"
            echo "- taskId: Required"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Validation successful"
```
